text: Four times: (1) hold the DEAD ACUTE (right of Æ) down - about 1 s the first time, a little longer each time; (2) let go; (3) press  a  once.
Twice: (1) hold  j  with your right hand and keep holding; (2) with your left hand press Alt+Tab and let go of Alt and Tab; (3) let go of  j ; (4) press Alt+Tab to come back to THIS window.
Twice: (1) click into Notepad; (2) hold  j  there and keep holding; (3) with your left hand press Alt+Tab to come back to THIS window, let go of Alt and Tab; (4) let go of  j .
Hold RIGHT Shift down until a Filter Keys box appears (about 8 s), then let go of Shift. Press Escape to close the box. If THIS window is not in front, click it.
(1) Click into Notepad; (2) press and release RIGHT Ctrl (right of the space bar, past AltGr) twice; (3) press and release Escape; (4) click back into THIS window.
